summary: Found 15 hardcoded configuration issues across the project. The most critical are the two hardcoded pricing API URLs in pricing.ts (LITELLM_PRICES_URL, LLM_PRICES_URL) which are production external endpoints embedded in source code. Several application data directory paths (~/.codex, ~/.hermes, ~/.openclaw) are hardcoded but most support environment variable overrides. The build script has hardcoded version/appId/metadata that should be sourced from package.json. The renderer API base path ('/api') is hardcoded in the frontend bundle. Overall, the project follows reasonable patterns (env var overrides, platform-appropriate defaults) but would benefit from centralizing configuration into a config module or .env file.
